scripts.build: cd packages/tui && bun run build && cd ../ai && bun run build && cd ../agent && bun run build && cd ../coding-agent && bun run build
scripts.check: biome check --write --error-on-warnings . && tsgo --noEmit && bun run check:installer && bun run check:browser-smoke
scripts.version:patch: bun pm version patch --no-git-tag-version && bun scripts/sync-versions.js && rm -rf node_modules packages/*/node_modules bun.lock && bun install
scripts.version:minor: bun pm version minor --no-git-tag-version && bun scripts/sync-versions.js && rm -rf node_modules packages/*/node_modules bun.lock && bun install
scripts.version:major: bun pm version major --no-git-tag-version && bun scripts/sync-versions.js && rm -rf node_modules packages/*/node_modules bun.lock && bun install
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run clean && bun run build && bun run check
scripts.publish: bun run prepublishOnly && bun publish --access public
scripts.publish:dry: bun run prepublishOnly && bun publish --access public --dry-run
